CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Patriarchs Abraham? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Patriarchs Abraham to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Patriarchs Abraham with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Bible Patriarchs Abraham has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Patriarchs Abraham.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Annunciation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Annunciation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Annunciation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Annunciation has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Annunciation.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zacchaeus the Tax Collector.
   B. Use Zacchaeus the Tax Collector to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Zacchaeus the Tax Collector has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of My Family Family members? (1 mark)
   A. Use My Family Family members to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Family Family members.
   C. Apply the teaching of My Family Family members with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say My Family Family members has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Thoughts and feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Thoughts and feelings.
   B. Use Thoughts and feelings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Thoughts and feelings has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Making choices.
   B. Use Making choices to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Making choices has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Making choices with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

11. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Samson kills a Lion? (1 mark)
   A. Say Samson kills a Lion has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.
   C. Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Parable of the mustard seed and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Trust: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Truthfulness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Apply the teaching of Bible Patriarchs Abraham with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

5. A — Apply the teaching of The Annunciation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of My Family Family members with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Making choices with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

11. C — Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Parable of the mustard seed; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Trust:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
